verdict.rationale: Make documents custom webhooks that create a URL external apps or other scenarios call to trigger execution, with optional queued or scheduled processing. Custom apps include a Webhooks component, and the MCP server lets AI clients view and modify webhooks, so event-driven subscription into Make is clearly supported. However, the evidence frames webhooks as inbound triggers, and nothing shows a way to subscribe to Make's own platform events (e.g., scenario runs or failures) as outbound webhooks. Missing for 10: documented outbound event subscriptions for Make platform events, event catalog/payload docs, delivery/retry/signature guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration.
